description: An arbitrarily indexed family of finite sets has a system of distinct representatives if and only if the union at every finite subset of indices has at least as many elements as indices.
signature:
Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_exists_injective.{u, v} {ι : Type u} {α : Type v} [DecidableEq α]
  (t : ι → Finset α) :
  (∀ (s : Finset ι), s.card ≤ (s.biUnion t).card) ↔ ∃ f, Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ (x : ι), f x ∈ t x
